d.title: Toaru Kagaku no Railgun: Misaka-san wa Ima Chuumoku no Mato desu kara
d.en: A Certain Scientific Railgun OVA: Since Misaka-san is the Center of Attention Right Now...
d.jp: とある科学の超電磁砲 御坂さんはいま注目の的ですから
d.synopsis: Continuing after the Level Upper incident, another phenomenon torments Misaka. A phenomenon called "Someone's Watching," its effect feels like the electricity in one's body flow backwards. With the help of her friends, Misaka fights against the unknown enemy.
